aspect: Suspicion of informers is not paranoia
description: Surveillance of diaspora communities by home-state services is documented in multiple countries. The reasonable response is caution, and caution at scale is the destruction of a community.
energy_note: A room where everyone is slightly careful.

aspect: Positions harden because the stakes are family
description: Political disagreement in a diaspora is not abstract - each position implies something about whose relatives deserve what. Friendships of twenty years end over it.
energy_note: Losing a friend over a ceasefire.

aspect: SECONDARY - the isolated ones fare worst
description: The person who withdraws from the community after a political falling-out loses their only trauma-literate social environment and is then alone in a country that does not understand any of it.
energy_note: Alone among people, and alone among your own.
